data.cultural_impact: The name Barbra holds a significant cultural impact as it is derived from the Greek word 'bárbaros', which denoted foreigners or barbarians. data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Barbra can be attributed to its connection to Babylon in the Bible.
